sources.name: example-venue-ical
sources.notes: Placeholder. Many Houston venues/galleries/makerspaces run the WordPress 'The Events Calendar' plugin, which publishes a free iCal feed at <site>/events/?ical=1 with no API key required. Find a real one and point this at it, or add your own via `events source add`.

sources.name: example-instagram-lead
sources.notes: Placeholder 'lead' source: a known account/page worth checking manually. No automated adapter exists for Instagram/Facebook (would need Meta Graph API credentials) — this just keeps it on your coverage radar as a source to check by hand, distinct from an automated feed.

sources.name: houston-center-contemporary-craft-ical
sources.notes: Confidence: medium-high. crafthouston.org's events page uses WordPress's 'The Events Calendar' plugin (confirmed via its standard 'sync to Google/iCal/Outlook' export language), whose default iCal export URL convention is <events-page>?ical=1. This URL was NOT directly fetched/verified (this sandbox blocks outbound fetches) - test with 'events ingest --source houston-center-contemporary-craft-ical' once on real hosting.

sources.name: houston-public-library-lead
sources.notes: Confirmed (via search) to support iCal subscription per-event, but the exact feed/export URL wasn't found. Runs frequent free workshops - fits maker/books/gardening/family programming well. Visit directly once on real hosting to find the actual subscribe link, then reconfigure as type=ical.

sources.name: artshound-haa-cultural-calendar-lead
sources.notes: Houston Arts Alliance's citywide cultural events aggregator (formerly Artshound) - potentially high-leverage since it may cover many galleries/theaters/museums in one feed. Custom platform (hookandshell.com), no confirmed feed format found via search. Needs direct page inspection once on real hosting.

sources.name: orange-show-visionary-art-lead
sources.notes: Orange Show Center for Visionary Art - exhibitions, concerts, films, classes/workshops. Platform/feed format unconfirmed via search. Needs direct page inspection once on real hosting.

sources.name: asia-society-texas-lead
sources.notes: Asia Society Texas Center - uses Salesforce for ticketing (asiasocietytexascenter.my.salesforce-sites.com), so likely no simple WordPress-style ical export. Needs direct page inspection once on real hosting to find any feed option.
